# Commands from a nested working directory use the nearest ancestor board.
exec weft$exe init
mkdir nested/child
cd nested/child
exec weft$exe add 'Found from child directory'
stdout 'Created 001 Found from child directory'
cd ../..
exists tasks/backlog/001-found-from-child-directory.md
! exists nested/child/tasks
exec weft$exe show 001 --json
json
stdout '"title": "Found from child directory"'
